reposync state DIAGNOSIS VERDICT (sandbox-verified against the shipped binary): the v0→v1 migration is a **lossless envelope wrap** — the flat payload is byte-for-byte the new `repo_sync` product payload (envelope cut in synckit d8dde6a "hard-cut exact schema v1", first shipped v0.20.0 of the synckit dep line; no migration helper ever existed; CHANGELOG/docs silent; both repos' cc-notes EMPTY). The error is synckit's shared hostregistry code (ErrStateSchema state.go:25, exactObject :246, product namespace :140) — same InitializeState never-repairs contract as synckit's own state. Parsing happens on EVERY reposync command, so the wedge was total.

Verified recipe (now carried by both machine lanes): cp -p backup → jq wrap into `{schema:{identity:"repo-sync-state-v1",version:1,fingerprint:fd74def9…781}, host_registry:{self,hosts}, repo_sync:{default_location,repos,local_repos,settings-with-explicit-defaults}}` → chmod 600 → GATE on `reposync repo ls` listing the full registry (any error restores the backup; the fingerprint check fails clean, never corrupts) → `reposync install` regenerates the manifest (reposync has NO host add; install is its analogue). Explicit defaults required — decodeProduct no longer applies them; zero durations hard-fail.

Fresh-state REJECTED with evidence: the 40+ tracked repos are NOT re-derivable (discover only classifies, never registers), `local_repos` are deliberately never synced to peers (gone for good), tombstones vanish (removals resurrect on merge), and re-adds hardcode Trunk:"main". Probe binary left at /tmp/reposync-probe (local machine) for pre-validating candidate files.

For C records: one more synckit bug to file — ErrStateSchema's "manually recreate" message with no repair path, no tooling, no changelog/doc of the hard cut, affecting every product namespace sharing hostregistry (synckit, reposync at minimum).
